content: Uysha mitsicogman Jesucristo tincutsicushgan
Mastapis Jesús caynog nergan: “Uysha cunchaman puncupa mana yaycog cäga suwami caycan.
Cuncha puncupa yaycog cagmi itsanga uyshapa duëñun caycan.
Musyashgantsinogpis cuncha puncuta quichapaptin uyshapa duëñonga jutinpa jutinpa gayan uyshancunata.
Tsaynog gayashganta mayashpanmi cunchapita uyshancuna yargapäcamun.
Lapan yargamurnami duëñunpa guepanta aywapäcun, duëñunta reguishpan.
Jäpa captenga manami gatirantsu. Gatiränanpa trucanga gueshpirmi aywacärin.”
Tincutsiypa tsaynog Jesús yachatsiptinmi tsaycho cag runacuna mana tantyapäcorgantsu tsaynog tincutsir imata yachaycätsishgantapis.
Tsauraga Jesús caynog nergan: “Nogaga caycä uysha cuncha puncunogmi.

Tsaymi cuncha puncupa uyshacuna yaycushgannog nogata chasquicamag runacuna gloriaman yaycapäcongapag. Uyshacuna ali guewacho weray weray cashgannogmi nogata chasquicamagcuna ali cawayta tarengapag. Manarag shamuptë waquin runacuna lutanta yachatsishpan puripäcorgan caynog nir: ‘Nogatami Tayta Dios cachamashga wilacuyninta wilacunäpag.’ Tsaynog yachatsiptinpis Tayta Diosman rasunpa yäracogcuna paycunata manami chasquicärergantsu.
Suwaga shamun suwacunanpag, wanutsinanpag y ushacätsinanpagmi. Nogami itsanga shamushcä chasquicamag runacuna imayyagpis cushishgala cawapäcunanpag.
“Tsaynogpis uyshanta ali mitseg runanogmi caycä. Uyshancunata wanuy caway mitsegnin salvashgannogmi
nogapis uyshäcunata salvanä-raycu wanushagpag.
Pägu-raycula mitsipacog cäga löbu shamuptin gueshpirmi aywacun. Tsaynog aywacun duëñun mana cashpanmi. Tsauraga löbu gaticachaptin uyshacuna gueshpir matsipa matsirmi may-tsaypapis aywacärin.
Tsaynog mitsipacog cäga uyshacuna elgaptinpis manami imapis gocuntsu.

“Nogaga rasunpa ali mitseg runanogmi caycä. Tsaymi Taytäta reguishgänog y pay nogata reguimashgannog nogapis uyshäcunata reguë y uyshäcunapis nogata reguiman. Tsaynogpis uyshäcuna-raycumi wanushagpag.

Manami caylachötsu uyshäcuna caycan, sinöga may-tsaychöpis caycanmi. Paycunapis nishgäcunata mayar cäsucärimangami. Tsaymi paycunatapis shuntamushag juc cunchalachöna cananpag. Tsaynogpis juclaylanami uysha mitsegnin cangapag.
“Taytäta cäsucur uyshäcuna-raycumi wanushag. Nircurnami cawarimushagpag. Tsaynog cäsucog captëmi Taytä cushicun.
Noga munayniyogmi caycä wanunäpag y cawarimunäpagpis. Tsaymi quiquë mana munaptëga pipis mana wanutsimanmantsu. Tsaynog captinpis Taytä nimashgannogmi wanushag y wanushgäpita cawarimushag.”
Jesús tsaynog parlaptinmi Israel runacunapa waquin autoridänincuna yarpargan rasun cagta niycashganta y waquin cagna yarpargan quiquinpa yarpaynilanpita parlaycashganta.
Tsaymi waquin nipäcorgan: “Payta demonio löcutaycätsiptenga ¿imapagtag cäsucushun?”
Y waquin cagnami nipäcorgan: “Demonio löcutätsishga captenga manami tsaynog parlanmantsu. Tsaynogpis gapra runata manami aliyätsinmantsu cargan.”
Runacuna Jesucristuta mana chasquicushgan
Diciembri quilla templupa aniversariuncho fiestata rurapäcuptinmi templucho Jesús puriycargan Salomón nishgan alarcho.

Tsaychömi Israel runacunapa autoridänincuna Jesusta tapupäcorgan: “¿Imayyagtag shuyäshayqui rasun cagta wilapäcamänayquipag? Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashgayquita o mana cashgayquitapis jucla wilapäcamay.”
Tsaynog nipäcuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Maynami gamcunata wilashcä. Wilaptëpis manami criyipäcamanquitsu. Taytäpa munayninwan milagrucunata ruraycaptëpis manami criyipäcamanquitsu.
Gamcunaga mana criyipäcamanquitsu uyshäcuna mana cashpayquimi.
“Uyshäcunami itsanga pï cashgätapis tantyashpan cäsucaman. Tsaynogpis reguëmi uyshäcuna maygan maygan cashganta.
Nogata chasquicamashganpitami Tayta Diospa naupancho imayyagpis cawangapag. Maquëcho captinnaga manami pipis guechumanganatsu.
Maquëcho caycarga Taytäpa maquinchöpis caycanmi. Taytä lapanpagpis munayniyog captinmi diablupis ni demoniupis ni pipis paypa maquinpita guechongatsu.
Taytäwan nogaga juclaylami caycä.”
Tsaynog niptinmi tsay autoridäcuna Jesusta sagmayta munapäcorgan.
Tsauraga Jesús nergan: “Gamcuna ricashcanquimi atsca milagrucunata Taytäpa munayninwan rurashgäta. ¿Tsaynog alita rurashgäpitacu sagmayta munaycämanqui?”
Tsauraga tsay runacuna nipäcorgan: “Manami alita rurashgayquipitatsu sagmayta munapäcö, sinöga runala caycar Dios-tucuycashgayquipitami.”
Tsaynog nipäcuptin Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diosnintsipa palabrancho caynogmi niycan: ‘Gamcunaga dioscunami carcaycanqui.’

Musyapäcunquimi Tayta Diospa palabrancho lapanpis rasun cagla cashganta. Tsaymi Diospa wilacuyninta unay mayagcunapag: ‘Gamcunaga dioscunami carcaycanqui’ niycaptenga ¿imanirtag: ‘Diospa tsurinmi caycä’ niptë yarpapäcunqui lutanta niycashgäta? Quiquin Tayta Diosnintsimi cay patsaman cachamashga.
“Milagruta rurashgäcuna Taytä munashgannog mana captenga ama criyipäcamaytsu: ‘Diospa tsurinmi caycä’ niptëpis.
Nishgäcunata mana criyirpis milagruta rurashgäcunata ricaycarga tantyacäriy Taytäwan tsay yarpayla cashgäta.”
Tsaynog nishganpitami Jesusta yapay prësu tsaritsiyta munargan. Tsaynog munaptinpis Jesús tsaypita aywacorgan.
Nircurnami Jordán mayu tsimpanman Jesús cutergan. Tsaychömi naupata Juan Bautista bautizargan runacunata.

Jesús tsaycho cashganta musyarmi tsayman atsca runacuna aywargan. Paycuna caynogmi nipäcorgan: “Ima milagrutapis Juan Bautista manami rurashgatsu. Tsaynog captinpis Jesuspita lapan nishgancunaga rasun caglami caycan.”
Tsaynog nirmi atsca runacuna criyipäcorgan Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta.

footnotes.text: Cay patsacho Jesús purinan witsanga runacunapa uyshan juc cunchalacho talucashgami punupäcog. Tsaychömi uysha täpag runa puncuta quichapaptin uyshapa duëñun uyshancunata jutinpa jutinpa gayag.
Jesucristo cawashgan witsan uysha mitsegcuna uyshancunata washargan atogpita, löbupita, leonpita y ösupitapis.
Dios cashganta unay runacuna pipagpis nergan mandag cashganpitami. Tsaypita masta musyanayquipag liyinqui Salmo 82.6.
